headline_signatures.Rule30Submission.prefix_period_iff: theorem prefix_period_iff (g : Nat → Bool → Bool → Bool) (x : Nat → Bool) : ∀ n P, PrefixPer g x n P ↔ 2 ^ prefixExp g x n ∣ P
headline_signatures.Rule30Submission.prefix_window_bound: theorem prefix_window_bound (g : Nat → Bool → Bool → Bool) (x : Nat → Bool) (a m : Nat) : prefixExp g x (a + 2 * m) - prefixExp g x a ≤ m + Q (prefixExp g x a) m ∧ prefixExp g x (a + 2 * m) - prefixExp g x a ≤ m + Q 0 m
